text:
Noelle Carter: Hi all  starting tomorrow! Quick Notion hiccup I signed in with my personal Google and now Notion shows two accounts (one with my SSO email but no access). I can view Team docs from the SSO account but not edit. Which account should I use and how do we reconcile so I can duplicate onboarding templates? :confused:

devex: Welcome Noelle! Always use your company SSO account (email on your offer). If Notion created a separate personal account, we need to merge them. Steps we usually follow:
1) Sign out of Notion completely and clear site cookies.
2) Sign back in with your company SSO (SSO via Okta).
3) If you still see two accounts, DM us the two Notion profile emails and we'll file a merge request with Notion support.

docs-bot: Tip: provide both account profile URLs when you DM devex. Example profile URL: `https://www.notion.so/me` (open while signed into each account to copy). Also include your Redwood employee ID.

Noelle Carter: Thanks. While the merge is pending, can I duplicate the "Eng Onboard Checklist" and work in my personal workspace, then move it into Team space after merge? Concerned about losing properties or breaking any automation that expects a specific page ID.

Ibrahim Khan: You can duplicate and later move it. Caveat: some automations look for canonical page IDs under Team > Onboarding. If you move the duplicate into Team space, set a `CopiedFrom` property with the original page URL and update the `Owner` property. If you want managers to see it immediately, invite them as Editors on the duplicate.

Carmen Ruiz: Another path: ask for temporary page-level Editor on the canonical checklist (devex can add Editor to your SSO account) so you edit in-place without moving pages. That's less work for automations. When you request, include the canonical page link and say "temporary Editor for Noelle for onboarding edits" and specify duration (e.g., 14 days).

devex: Correct. If you need immediate editing and the merge will take time, DM us a request like:
```
@devex please add Editor on https://redwood.notion.so/Eng-Onboard-xyz for Noelle Carter (noelle@redwood.com) Duration: 14 days Reason: complete ramp notes and duplicate PR Postmortem template
```
We'll do page-level editors rather than workspace-level by default.

docs-bot: Quick checklist about duplicating DB templates so you don't lose fields:
- Database properties copy on duplicate.
- If the original board had automation (Zapier/Make), moving the page may not reattach automations; the canonical ID matters.
- To preserve automation behavior, either get Editor on canonical or add a `no-automation` property so scripts skip the copy until it's promoted.

Noelle Carter: Good to know. A separate ask: HR (Maya) set up an auto-populate integration that should create a new row in the Onboarding DB for my account, but it didn't because of the duplicate-account issue. Who owns that integration?

People Ops (Maya): That's on the People Ops -> HR integrations board. I own the BambooHR -> Notion sync but devex and eng-platform manage the auth bits. If there's a merge issue we can re-run the sync once your SSO account is confirmed. DM me the expected row fields and I'll check the logs.

Ibrahim Khan: If you need a rapid workaround, tell People Ops to create the row manually and tag your manager; then devex can set a temporary Editor so you can edit the new row directly.

Noelle Carter: I'll DM devex the two profile URLs and my employee ID, send People Ops the expected row details, and ping here once it's resolved. Thanks everyone! :wave: :raised_hands:
